## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified.
- [ ] Independent review requested.
- [ ] Applicable tests/build/checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and decisions are consistent.
- [ ] No secrets or unnecessary identifying data.
- [ ] Permissions, failures and privacy reviewed when affected.
- [ ] Applicable DoD verified.

Documentation-only edit: check content, sources and links; do not claim code tests were run. Do not mark external configuration as active without evidence.
